name: Lens
subtitle: Lens camera builds
description: Builds of the Lens camera app.

apps.name: Lens
apps.subtitle: Native iPhone camera
apps.localizedDescription: Native iPhone camera with PNG and RAW capture, Portrait and Low Light modes.
apps.versionDescription: - Diagnostic: on first launch Lens shows a one-time sheet listing every front camera format that reaches 60 fps (size, aspect ratio, still size) and whether Lens can use 60 fps on the front camera. You can select and copy the text. It doesn't change how the camera works.
